children: U.S. rodent control innovator's Q3 revenue rose 42% sequentially and 59% yr/yr to record high
Company reported record gross profit, up 40% sequentially and 84% yr/yr
Net loss widened both sequentially and yr/yr
Company expects continued growth in e-commerce and B2B channels
Company sees direct B2B as a key growth driver going forward
Company aims to build repeat B2B business in targeted domestic verticals
E-COMMERCE GROWTH - Co said e-commerce revenue, particularly through Amazon, drove sequential and yr/yr revenue gains
SUBSCRIPTION EXPANSION - Subscription revenue and subscriber count rose sharply, supporting recurring revenue base
B2B SALES EFFORTS - Process changes and sales team expansion contributed to sequential B2B revenue growth
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the agricultural chemicals peer group is "buy"
